senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) same, esp. firmly established distinctive usage, religious observance.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11a:10">Ab. Zar. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שריפה לאו ח׳ היא</he> the burning of costly materials at funerals is not a specific (gentile) religious custom.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:8">Num. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. <he>חקה חקקתי</he> I have ordained a ceremony (without giving a reason).
Ib. four (laws) דכתיב בהן ח׳ in reference to which the word ḥukkah (rule without reason) is used.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:8">Ib.</cite> <he>לך אני מגלה … אבל לאחר ח׳</he> unto thee I reveal the reason …, but to anybody else it is a rule; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוּקּוֹת</he>, <he>חֻקּוֹת</he>. Tanḥ.
